texts.facts: 4 20-04-2018 Petitioners in the present case are a Private Limited Company and a truck owner who have moved this Court seeking quashing of the First Information Report giving rise to Manjhi P.S. Case No. 287 of 2017 (G.R. No. 8863 of 2017) registered under Sections 188/420 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 20 of the Cigarette and Other Tobacco Products Act, 2003 (in short 'COTPA') read with Section 48(2) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioners has relied upon a judgment of this Court in Criminal Writ Jurisdiction Case No. 119 of 2016 passed on 08.04.2016 whereunder the learned co-ordinate bench K. G. Paan Products Pvt. Ltd. & Anr vs The State Of Bihar, Through The ... on 20 April, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128406638/ 1 of this Court had examined the legality and validity of institution of a First Information Report lodged by the Food Safety Officer U/S 58 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and the charge sheet filed thereunder. He has also relied upon another co- ordinate bench judgment of this Court in the case of Pankaj Chhabra @ Pankaj & Ors. Vs. The State of Bihar & Ors., reported in 2016 (3) PLJR 242, whereunder this Court had examined a similar case where there was a detention of a truck and seizure of Paan Masala / Zarda in terms of Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
